inputs.text: Environment concept art ONLY. Empty snowbound medieval fortress courtyard with no people anywhere. Wide panoramic hand painted illustration for a 2D side scrolling fantasy game. A continuous lateral back wall of elaborately carved blue-grey stone ramparts and gothic gatehouses, heraldic animal carvings, deep blue gold-trimmed banners, snow-covered ledges, distant snowy mountain peaks and pale clouds visible above the wall. All buildings behind a broad clear horizontal foreground pavement. Camera facing the back wall straight on from the side, no central road leading into the distance. Bottom 45 percent of frame entirely clear flat paving stones across the whole width, very subtle perspective. Rich fine textures and detailed stonework, coherent elegant fantasy illustration, warm touches of gold against blue-white snow. Empty architecture and landscape, no human figures, no warrior, no knight, no animals, no character, no text, no UI.
